purpose: Define reusable test data, state snapshots, identities, mocked endpoints and environment setup as explicit fixture identities separate from production data/state.

topics.name: Test Fixture Identity
topics.purpose: Define reusable test data, state snapshots, identities, mocked endpoints and environment setup as explicit fixture identities separate from production data/state.

semantics.identity_rule: Each fixture has an explicit identity/revision.
semantics.data_rule: Fixture data is explicitly classified as test data unless sourced from governed production evidence.
semantics.state_rule: Required initial runtime/config/data state is explicit.
semantics.secret_rule: Real production secrets are excluded unless a separately governed test requires them.
semantics.authority_rule: Fixture possession grants no production resource access.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.

hard_gates.condition: test fixture mistaken for production source
production secret copied into fixture by default
fixture identity equals tested resource identity
